standard_prerequisites.name: The comparison functor is fully faithful, which follows from the computation of Hom groups as a colimit along the descending system
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to essential surjectivity.

standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle on quasi-compact opens reduces the essential surjectivity to the affine case once the Mayer-Vietoris condition is checked with the gluing statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Organises the proof and handles the union step.

standard_prerequisites.name: Over an affine base a perfect complex is described concretely, and the algebra statement says that a perfect complex on the limit is the colimit of perfect complexes on the approximants
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives essential surjectivity in the affine case, which finishes the proof.

core_obligations: Introduce the condition that the colimit of the categories of perfect objects on the approximations is equivalent to the category of perfect objects on the limit for a given quasi-compact open, and note that full faithfulness is already known (proof lines 7538-7546).
Verify the Mayer-Vietoris condition of the induction principle, using the gluing of objects along the two opens and their intersection (proof lines 7547-7562).

Reduce to the affine case and use the concrete description of perfect complexes there to translate the essential surjectivity into the algebra statement about perfect complexes on a limit of rings (proof lines 7563-7590).
Conclude that the condition holds for all quasi-compact opens, hence that the comparison functor is an equivalence and the category is the colimit as asserted (proof lines 7590-7595).
proof_roadmap: Full faithfulness from the Hom computation, reducing to essential surjectivity (proof lines 7538-7546).
The Mayer-Vietoris condition via gluing (proof lines 7547-7562).
Affine case by the algebra statement on colimits of perfect complexes (proof lines 7563-7595).
